name: public-repo-answers
request: When someone asks Scout something on the code host, in an issue or a pull request comment, Scout answers in a Slack thread and copies its whole answer back there as a comment. On a public repository that can leak what people said in Slack. Copy the answer only onto private repositories. On a public one, or when the code host won't say whether it's private, comment with a pointer instead: `I've answered in the Slack thread: <link>` (`I've answered in Slack.` when there's no link), and when the answer mentions pull requests, a second paragraph listing their links: `Pull request: <link>`, or `Pull requests: <a>, <b>` for several, each once.
